clips.title: The story
paras: A Keg of Shindigger Stout is a barrel of potent dwarven ale brewed and guarded by the riflemen and soldiers garrisoned within Dun Garok. Desired by the Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill, it serves not as an evening drink, but as a deceitful delivery vehicle for newly synthesized plagues.

Dun Garok stands as a formidable dwarven bastion in the southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills, fiercely maintained by the dwarves of Ironforge. Within its entrenched barracks and mess halls, the stout-hearted defenders share barrels of Shindigger Stout to weather the cold and the grinding siege against regional enemies. The brew is robust and plentiful, making it a staple of the garrison's day-to-day survival.
